correctness.rationale: For a<b, 2(T(b)-T(a))=(b-a)(a+b-1). The two positive factors have opposite parity, one strictly smaller, and product divisible by 2m. The odd member O has d=gcd(O,w) dividing w; coprimality forces the even E to be divisible by 2m/d. Thus 2b-1>=d+2m/d. Taking O=d,E=2m/d attains equality and makes integer difference m. Two distinct odd divisors cannot tie since d1*d2=2m impossible parity; equality forces a unique earlier witness. Independently scanned all m=1..2000 using direct first repeat and checked uniqueness and prime power boundary formulas; m=1 included. Indices are positive, T(1)=0.
